messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty Alert PD-INC-9421 fired: auth-validate service > 15% 5xx across prod-eu and prod-us
incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-9421 created for auth-validate error spike (trigger: 5xx rate >15% over 5m)
Ravi: ackd. I'm oncall — taking lead. pinging Nina and Jorge for infra and signer context
Nina: here. looking at graphs now. which endpoints are failing mostly?
Ravi: /v1/token/validate and some service-to-service verify calls. 401/500 mix. spike started ~8m ago
Jorge: logs show repeated errors: `JWTValidationError: kid not found in JWKS` and some `SignatureVerificationError`
Tanya: could be JWKS mismatch or a partial key publish. Did we just rotate keys in the last 10m?
Nina: checking deploy timeline
```
# deploy history
kubectl -n prod rollout history deploy/auth-signer --revision=23
# pipeline: auth-signer release/2026-03-15 -> key rotation + publish
```
Nina: signer pod logs show it generated key new-k2026-03 and attempted to PUT to key-store, got a 403 from key-service
Jorge: 403 from key-service -> maybe IAM role or service account token expired during deployment
Ravi: curl jwks from a validator pod and from public edge cache
```
# from validator pod
kubectl -n prod exec deploy/auth-validator-0 -- curl -s https://auth.internal.redwood/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
"old-k2025"
# from CDN edge (via jump host)
curl -s https://auth.redwood.com/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
"old-k2025"
```
Ravi: validators and edge still serving old key only. Meanwhile tokens being minted with `kid=new-k2026-03` apparently
Tanya: confirm what tokens look like hitting our edge
```
# sample request log
2026-03-15T10:15:02Z GET /api/payments 401 "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...","kid":"new-k2026-03" -> signature check failed at validator
```
Jorge: so signer likely succeeded in signing locally but failed to publish the JWKS to key-service due to 403. However, some signer instances may have their local key active and are issuing tokens, creating the mismatch
Nina: mitigation options: 1) fix key-service permission and re-publish JWKS 2) roll auth-signer back to previous release so it stops issuing tokens with unknown kid 3) temporarily configure validators to accept previous-key fallback for a small window (security review needed)
Ravi: let's try to publish keys manually from the signer pod with admin token and see if key-service accepts it
```
# attempt manual publish
kubectl -n prod exec deploy/auth-signer-0 -- /bin/sh -c 'curl -s -X POST "https://key-service.internal/v1/keys" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY_ADMIN" -d @/tmp/jwks.json -w "%{http_code}"'
403
```
Ravi: still 403. key-service logs show `policy: allow only service-account=key-pusher` and auth-signer is running as `sa=deployer` right now
Jorge: that matches: the deploy created a new pod with wrong serviceAccount due to a templating bug in the helm chart for this release
Tanya: short mitigation: 1) patch signer deployment to use the correct serviceAccount and restart so it can publish 2) if restart takes time, roll back to previous release where signer didn't attempt rotation
Nina: I'm going to patch the deployment to set serviceAccountName=key-pusher and then trigger a restart. Will check RBAC rules first
Ravi: do it. I'll open a temporary maintenance note for product/support and also prepare CDN purge commands if publish succeeds
Nina: patch applied
```
kubectl -n prod patch deploy auth-signer -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"serviceAccountName":"key-pusher"}}}}'
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/auth-signer
```
Nina: auth-signer pods restarted. checking admin publish endpoint
```
kubectl -n prod exec deploy/auth-signer-0 -- curl -s -X POST "https://key-service.internal/v1/keys" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY_ADMIN" -d @/tmp/jwks.json -w "%{http_code}"
200
```
Ravi: publish returned 200. Now need to ensure validators and CDN see it
Jorge: triggering validator JWKS refresh (admin endpoint) across pods
```
kubectl -n prod get deploy auth-validator -o name | xargs -I{} kubectl -n prod exec $(kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=auth-validator -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/refresh-jwks
```
Ravi: invalidated CDN caches for JWKS too
```
# CDN purge (edge)
fastly purge https://auth.redwood.com/.well-known/jwks.json
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id ABCD1234 --paths "/.well-known/jwks.json"
```
ops-bot: CDN purge queued: fastly job id fsty-993, cloudfront invalidation id inv-20260315-77
Jorge: validator logs now show both keys
```
auth-validator INFO JWKS updated: ["old-k2025","new-k2026-03"]
auth-validator INFO validation success for token kid=new-k2026-03
```
Ravi: error rate dropping: 5xx from 18% -> 2.1% over last 4m
Tanya: good. Now confirm customer impact and affected tenants
```
# quick trace counts (lightweight)
SELECT tenant, count(*) FROM traces WHERE service='auth-validator' AND status >= 400 AND timestamp > now() - interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY tenant
```
Ravi: top counts: tenant:merchant-x 320, tenant:billingcorp 210, tenant:internal-monitoring 18 — total ~548 failed validations during window
Nina: many of those were frontend token checks causing 401s on login, some services retried and recovered
Jorge: severity: P1 for auth availability — customer visible but no credentials leaked. recommend customer comms for the two big tenants and a postmortem
Ravi: acknowledged. I'll escalate to SRE leader if any regression. For now, mitigation complete — monitoring
incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-9421 acknowledged by Ravi; status=mitigated (monitoring)
pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-9421 status set to "acknowledged" by Ravi
Ravi: handoff to Jorge for the next hour to watch metrics and coordinate any outbound messages
Jorge: taking over. I'll also create incidents/pm-9421 and attach timeline + logs
Tanya: post-incident follow-ups: 1) fix helm chart templating bug that set wrong serviceAccount (owner: Jorge) 2) add pre-cutover check in deploy pipeline: verify key-service publish and jwks endpoint returns new kid accessible from a validator and public edge (owner: Nina) 3) add alert rule specifically for `kid not found` spikes with runbook link (owner: Ravi) 4) consider short-lived tolerant validation window during rotation (security review needed) (owner: Security)
Ravi: adding these to tracker and assigning owners. I'll post an interim status to #product-support and create a postmortem draft
Jorge: oncall handoff acknowledged. I'll keep thread open for 60m then archive
Ravi: thanks team. closing PD alert now.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-INC-9421 updated to status: mitigated (closed by Ravi)
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-9421-logs attached; postmortem doc placeholder: /incidents/INC-9421/postmortem
Ravi: will follow up with customer outreach for merchant-x and billingcorp. good job everyone :thumbsup:
